## Whole block, one line, several spots

```{.go mark="Rows - 1"}
row := Rows - 1
col := Rows - 1
```

## Restricted to a line

```{.go mark="2:Rows - 1"}
row := Rows - 1
col := Rows - 1
```

## Several specs, and a `;` that belongs to the text

Two backslashes: pandoc's attribute parser eats one, the filter splits at the
`;` that is left unescaped — so this is one spec for line 1 and one for line 3,
not four.

```{.go mark="1:for i := 0\\; i < n\\; i++;3:done"}
for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
}
done := true
```
